question: Why can student not revoke Cloud (Syntax error) in UntisX (endpoint /settings)?
answer: Check role student. Module Cloud may require higher permissions. Error Syntax error: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /settings and the database connection. Feature Cloud must be enabled.
